chunks: 13 – al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥamdān, al-Ḥuṣaynī, al-Junbulā’ī, Abū ʿAbdillāh.
A liar. Corrupt in madhhab. The possessor of an accursed doctrine. He is not to be regarded.
ai.seo_question: Who is al-Husayn ibn Hamdan and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book *Kitab al-Du'afa* describing the narrator al--Husayn ibn Hamdan. It characterizes him as a liar with a corrupt creed who holds an accursed doctrine and is therefore not worthy of being relied upon in hadith transmission.
